purpose: First empirical development/fitness evaluation of architectural-reasoning v1.2.4 vs current (v1.3.0). Pipeline validation, not D_test / final certification.
frozen_at: 2026-08-29T00:00:00Z (session-local timestamp; see individual artifact file mtimes for actual wall-clock order)

execution_method.description: Each (version, scenario) subject transcript is produced by spawning an independent Claude agent (via Claude Code's Agent tool, subagent_type general-purpose) with the skill's full text supplied as inline operating instructions, plus the scenario's request. Scenario input files (when present) are written to a real directory that the subject agent can inspect with Read/Glob/Grep -- files are NOT pasted inline, so file-scope discipline (reading only what's relevant) is a genuine, unforced choice by the subject agent.
execution_method.fidelity_note: This is a real, non-simulated model execution -- the model genuinely processes the given instructions and produces content none of this pipeline predicts or writes by hand. It is NOT identical to the native ~/.claude/skills/ auto-trigger mechanism: the skill is provided as inline instructions rather than through the skill-loading system, and the subagent's tool environment may not exactly match a typical interactive session's.
execution_method.model_identity: whatever model the Agent tool's general-purpose subagent type resolves to at spawn time; recorded per-transcript in transcripts/<version>/<scenario>/rollout_01.meta.json
execution_method.sampling_parameters: not independently controllable through the Agent tool interface used here; this is a recorded limitation, not an omission

judging_method.description: Absolute (non-pairwise) blinded scoring: each transcript is assigned an opaque id (evaluators.calibration.generate_blind_ids, seeded) before judging. A fresh judge agent (no memory of this conversation, spawned separately per transcript) scores exactly one transcript against a rubric derived from the IntentContract (Phi) hard invariants relevant to that scenario and the CapabilityContract (Gamma) required/forbidden behaviors -- never told which skill version produced it.
judging_method.blinding: version identity is never present in any judge prompt; the blind_map.json revealing version<->opaque-id is written before judging and not read again until after all 8 judgments are recorded
judging_method.pairwise_order_randomization: not used -- absolute scoring was chosen instead of pairwise preference judging for this pass; requirement is conditional on pairwise judging being used

deterministic_checks.mentions_escalation_phrase: case-insensitive presence of 'focused design' or 'full architecture' as a named mode -- checked for scenario 01 only (expected: absent)
deterministic_checks.mentions_status_labels: case-insensitive presence of >=2 of {resolved, regressed, still open, new} -- checked for scenario 02 only (expected: present), as a weak deterministic proxy cross-checked against the judge's invariant_adherence score, not a replacement for it

commitment: No skill file is modified during or between execution and judging. Aggregate results are not inspected until all 8 subject transcripts and all 8 judgments are recorded.
